mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units, it signals robust housing sector growth that increases consumer wealth and business investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend over the prior 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE has risen over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates housing market contraction that depresses consumer confidence and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals supply shock combined with monetary tightening that reduces corporate output and profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of INDPRO falling and FEDFUNDS rising fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index level exceeds 320 (indicating sustained high inflation), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 320.
